source: Decoded from a Radical Red v4.1 CFRU ROM (gRaidPartners at 0x1134178, gNumRaidPartners = 8 at 0x1134176). The ROM itself is not in this repository.
notes: The raid intro screen shows 3 partners chosen at random from those who have a spread for the current star level. Live candidates live in the RaidBattleIntro struct pointed to by 0x0203E038 while that screen is open.
Partner Pokemon are built at GetRandomRaidLevel() (the star's level range; 20-25 for 1-star in this ROM).
Ability slot 0 = hidden, 1 = first ability, 2 = second ability (same encoding as raid dens).
